Let's compare the plans side by side. Each row of this table appears as I talk about it, so viewers can follow along without reading ahead.
Here are the three things that matter most for project managers. First, how tasks are tracked. Second, how documents connect to them. Third, how easy reporting is.
Setting up a project takes four steps. Create the space, add your task list, invite the team, and pick the view you'll use every day.
So which one should you pick? If your team lives in documents, go with Notion. If you need detailed task tracking, go with ClickUp.

visual.heading: My verdict
items: Pick Notion if your work lives in docs
Pick ClickUp if you track lots of tasks
